Privacy Policy

Updated 16 October 2026

Your account

When you use Google sign-in, Firebase Authentication manages your sign-in identity. AIMER Society stores your Firebase user ID, email, name, Google profile photo URL, signup time, and latest sign-in time in Neon. We do not receive your Google password.

Your learning space

While browsing as a guest, favorites, pins, and recent activity are stored in this browser. When signed in, these preferences are also stored with your account so this dashboard can restore them across devices. Interests and your display name can be changed on your profile page. Learning progress inside separate subject websites is not tracked by this dashboard.

Sessions and service providers

A secure, HttpOnly cookie keeps your session for up to five days and is scoped to aimersociety.com. Integrated AIMER subdomains can use it to recognize your session. Google/Firebase provides sign-in, Neon stores account data, and Vercel hosts this website. The dashboard also loads Google Analytics; analytics may collect usage and device information under Google's policies.

Your choices

You can browse without an account, skip interest selection, edit your profile, clear recent activity, or sign out. Signing out removes this browser’s shared login session; it does not delete your account or previously saved data. Browser-local saves remain on that device. For account-data questions or deletion requests, use the contact details published on the AIMER Society website.
